Stock market news | Anthropic IPO plunge drags Nasdaq down

Anthropic completed a record $93.5 billion IPO. In its first full trading day the stock fell 12%, and after the initial session it was down nearly 9% overall, pulling down semiconductor and AI‑related shares.
The sell‑off spread to broader US markets, with the Nasdaq slipping more than 2% and overall US stocks retreating, highlighting the volatility of AI‑linked valuations.
